fields.value: Hexoloy SA flexural strength 380 MPa. Compressive strength 3900 MPa is the allowable 011b scored. Axial stress at the filed wall is 824.7 MPa at 562.2 kN.
fields.issue: Against 3900 MPa the contact factor is 4.73. Against 380 MPa it is 0.461, and the member itself fails. This card does not replace the 011b allowable.
fields.consequence: A joint sized to the flexural coupon rejects the tube that 011b accepted.
fields.next: MAINLINE-025 owns the allowable. No change here.
